items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: Nelson, what's his name, Kincaid. They had two clarinets, King Phillips and Nelson Kincaid.

ctx.x: How many pieces in the band?

Well, 14, I guess, 15, something like that. Nelson, what's his name, Kincaid. They had two clarinets, King Phillips and Nelson Kincaid. I don't remember the other violin player Handy brought here with him. They had three fiddles in the band.
Two clarinets, three fiddles, and what kind of other instruments?
